codemieAssistants.name: SDLC Development & Code Generation Assistant (Claude-Code)
codemieAssistants.description: Developer assistant powered by CodeMie and Claude-Code CLI (codemie-claude). Reads local design/checklist files (root/docs/design.md, root/docs/pr_checklist.md), executes codemie-claude via the terminal to generate code for https://github.com/utpal74/codemie-meetingnotes, pushes changes, and automatically opens a Pull Request on GitHub.
